visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man with a voluminous afro and colorful chest tattoos, wearing a black tank top, is shown in a gym. He is shouting with an wide-open mouth, looking directly at another man with bleached blonde hair and a beard who is wearing a white zip-up hoodie. The gym lighting is bright with fluorescent tubes on the ceiling. (2) The afro-haired man holds a transparent plastic container and takes out a hard-boiled egg. He stares at the egg with an exaggerated, comedic expression of shock. The background shows gym equipment like racks and benches. (3) The afro-haired man aggressively grabs the lapel of the bearded man's white hoodie, pulling him close. The bearded man appears distressed and confused. (4) The scene cuts to an outdoor city plaza during the day. A clean-cut man with glasses, wearing a blue suit jacket over a white shirt and tie, is dancing energetically. He holds a white smartphone in his hand while performing choreographed movements. The background includes modern city buildings and people walking.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) Loud, strained male shouting with high arousal starts the audio, accompanied by low-level gym ambient hum. (2) A rhythmic, percussive synth beat enters as vocal delivery becomes rhythmic and comedic, mimicking a popular meme song's cadence. (3) A sharp hard cut leads into an upbeat Mandarin pop song with a strong 4/4 electronic drum beat. (4) The male singer's vocals are bright and melodic, continuing through the end with synthesized textures and high spectral brightness.
